## Path to Achieving an A* in A-Level Chemistry
Welcome, students! The A-Level Chemistry curriculum is renowned for its vast experimental requirements, intricate organic reaction mechanisms, and demanding physical chemistry calculations. K-Education Hub provides a structured library of core study notes, topical worksheets, and actual exam past papers organized under three primary pathways: **CIE**, **Edexcel**, and **Other Exam Boards (Others)**.
:::

## Choose Your Exam Board

Select your specific exam board below to access actual past papers, syllabus-aligned study notes, and targeted reaction mechanism sheets:

::: {.program-grid}

::: {.program-card .chem-card}
### A-Level CIE Chemistry (9701)
**Cambridge Assessment International Education**

* Access academic notes and exam resources mapped from Paper 1 (Multiple Choice) to Paper 5 (Planning, Analysis and Evaluation of experimental data).
* [Explore CIE Resources →](cie/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.program-card .chem-card}
### A-Level Edexcel Chemistry
**Pearson Edexcel International Advanced Level (IAL)**

* Navigate the modular exam structure from IAS (Units 1-3) to IA2 (Units 4-6). Focus on mechanisms, thermodynamics, and laboratory investigation notes.
* [Explore Edexcel Resources →](edexcel/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.program-card .chem-card}
### Other Exam Boards (Others)
**AQA, OxfordAQA, and Advanced Supplementary Resources**

* Find supplementary topic worksheets, advanced physical chemistry calculations, and unified organic reaction mechanism reference guides.
* [Explore Other Resources →](others/index.qmd)
